# `DpFileList.bin` fixtures

Lead-written fixtures for the `DpFileList.bin` reader and the working-bin walk (step 4.21,
TC-BIN-05, 08, 09, 13, 21), generated by `scripts/provenance/fixtures/dpfl_fixtures.py`. Do not
edit them by hand; change the script and rerun it. The layout they follow is in
`docs/plans/team_compiler/pipeline.md` "DpFileList upgrade".

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `walk.bin` | the list a test installs as `download/DpFileList.bin`: `4cc_08_bins.cpk`, `4cc_61_midcup.cpk`, `4cc_99_test.cpk`, in that load order, built in the layout of the maintainer's PES 2021 list (header word 0, 48-byte NUL-padded records), with that list's 1204-byte zero tail; 1,364 bytes |
| `pes19_official.bin` | a real PES 2019 list, copied from an install's `download/` (2026-10-07): 29 entries, `4cc_01_db.cpk` to `4cc_69_midcup.cpk`; each record carries a number at offset 36 (28 for the first, down to 0 for the last), and record 4 (`4cc_08_bins.cpk`) a stray `0x0b` at offset 20; 3,173 bytes |
| `pes20_header_100.bin` | a real PES 2020 list, copied from an install's `download/` (2026-10-07): header word 100 where the other lists hold 0, 45 entries, `4cc_01_db.cpk` to `4cc_90_test.cpk`; 3,075 bytes |

`examples/DpFileList.bin` at the repository root is a real PES 2017 list (39 entries,
`4cc_01_db.cpk` to `4cc_90_test.cpk`, a 905-byte zero tail).
